correctness.rationale: The final domain is unordered collision-free configurations of exactly two points on the original six-edge K4 graph, with integral H1. The two-point Abrams cubical model is applicable because essential-vertex distances are at least one edge and triangle girth is three; its C0,C1,C2 ranks are 6,12,3. I separately reconstructed signed boundaries: d1*d2=0, ranks (5,3), the determinant of (three square boundaries,four F_i) in spanning-tree cycle coordinates is 2, while replacing F3 with the Y exchange cycle gives a unimodular determinant -1. The independent chain identity 2Y+sum_i F_i=d2(-1,1,-1) holds. Thus H1 is free of rank4, facial span has index2 and the integral lattice is Z^4+Z*(sum e_i/2). The alternating orientation convention gives gF_i=sgn(g)F_g(i) for 24 vertex permutations and torsion-freeness forces the sign action on Y. Graph cycle projection has kernel ZY and invariant functional sum takes primitive fixed u to 2, precluding an S4 retraction; ordinary signed permutation lattice has invariant index4, so lattices differ despite rational characters. No assertion of higher-particle equivariant homotopy follows.
